info.text:
The app says your crypto is up 150%. None of it is real.
Crypto investment scams cost Americans $7.2 billion in 2025, up from $2.57 billion in 2022 (FBI IC3).
It starts with a wrong-number text, builds trust for weeks, then moves you to a fake crypto app with fake profits and fees to withdraw.
Never pay a fee to unlock your money. Report scams at ic3.gov.
Sources: FBI IC3 annual reports (2023-2025).
News and education, not financial advice.
